numeric_policy: Raw base-10 decimal strings; finite positive target quantities; Decimal precision 28; 0.3025 ping per square metre; no pre-rounding; natural log serialized as finite float64.
rights_policy: Single-building count and blank notes do not prove full rights or one dwelling. Require externally reviewed source/detail evidence with immutable checksum/locator/version; otherwise exclude.
parking_policy: Zero parking count, reviewed zero detail count, blank type and nonpositive-free zero price/area must agree. Blank price/area require explicit reviewed schema meaning. Positive signal always excludes.
area_policy: Registered transferred building area including ancillary/common parts; no parking. Evidence must establish compatible full-rights basis and source definition. Never call it interior floor area.
availability_policy: Exact historical availability or conservative authenticated public observation bound. Never infer from scheduled days, release labels, registration periods or acquisition claims.
identity_policy: County/type/dataset-scoped official ID only with reviewed namespace/reuse evidence; preserve all occurrence locators and explicit predecessor edges; quarantine ambiguity.
evidence_policy: References are supplied by a reviewed recovery/staging process. The aggregate audit checks consistency, not authenticity. Synthetic test references never qualify as source evidence.
build_status: FOUNDATION_ONLY; full archive parser/detail attestation and versioned dataset builder remain prerequisites.
